# Architecture

Superopen is a local-first agent-harness CLI and web UI. It builds repository graphs, seeds project context and governance under `.so/`, captures coding-agent telemetry, and evaluates sessions to improve later agent work.

- `cmd/so` is the Go CLI entry point; start here for command wiring and user-visible command behavior.
- `internal/` contains the application packages: initialization and seeding (`initcmd`, `seed`, `harness`), repository graph and retrieval (`graph`, `retrieve`), project memory and governance (`memory`, `guardrails`, `recommend`, `eval`), agent integration and telemetry (`coding`, `inject`, `otlp`, `session`), and supporting configuration and storage.
- `sdk/go/` provides Go SDK semantic conventions and helpers.
- `web/` is the Next.js/TypeScript UI, including the local Sessions UI launched by `so dev`.
- `plugins/`, `templates/`, and `npm/` package integrations and agent-facing assets; keep generated marketplace or plugin outputs synchronized with their sources.
- `scripts/` holds install, release, and maintenance helpers; `docs/` contains user and contributor documentation.

For CLI changes, trace from `cmd/so` to the owning `internal` package and its tests. For UI work, inspect the relevant `web/` component, API route, and test configuration. Treat `.so/` as repository-local harness data read and written by both the CLI and UI.
